summary: PulseGuard v0.6.17 is a final UI/notification polish pass: BIOS update notifications work again, ASUS DriverHub opens the official web portal only, Quick Actions fill their card, Optimize panels are rebalanced, and Vendor Updates follows the approved spacious layout.

sections.heading: BIOS update notification repaired
sections.detail: The BIOS row is labeled UPDATE AVAILABLE • MANUAL for safety, and the popup now recognizes that status correctly. The notification is offered after a normal Full Health Scan and also after the automatic post-fix rescan if it has not already been shown in the session. BIOS flashing remains manual.

sections.heading: ASUS DriverHub is browser-only
sections.detail: OPEN ASUS DRIVERHUB now opens https://driverhub.asus.com/en in the default browser. PulseGuard never launches or installs the local DriverHub application; OPEN BOARD SUPPORT remains the exact motherboard fallback.

sections.heading: Dashboard Quick Actions fill the available card
sections.detail: The five Quick Action buttons now grow evenly with the Quick Actions panel, with centered icons and balanced spacing instead of leaving a large empty gap at the bottom.

sections.heading: Optimize upper panels rebalanced
sections.detail: OPTIMIZATION PROCESS now receives 55% of the upper work area and CHANGES RECORDED receives the exact remaining 45%, eliminating the oversized empty region in the Changes panel.

sections.heading: Vendor Updates layout finalized
sections.detail: Vendor buttons are larger, table rows are roomier, long descriptions wrap, and the final explanation column receives more width while still resizing with the Tools page.

sections.heading: v0.6.16 scan and CPU improvements preserved
sections.detail: Persistent Dashboard scan history, post-fix rescan history, decimal total background CPU display, responsive driver scanning, Windows driver-ranking safety, and the branded heartbeat remain intact.
